nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set to the deployer in the Owned constructor and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address written by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol string, set to FRELLY in the constructor.

Token decimals, set to 0 in the constructor.
Total token supply (1), read by totalSupply().
Mapping of token holder balances, indexed by address, updated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances, updated by approve and approveAndCall.
Public pure addition helper that adds two uint values and asserts the result is not smaller than the first operand.
Public pure subtraction helper that requires b <= a before subtracting.
Public pure multiplication helper that verifies a == 0 or c / a == b after multiplying.
Public pure division helper that requires a non-zero divisor.
Constructor of Owned that assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
Owner-only function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership transfer when called by the staged newOwner.
Constructor of the FrellyToken that initialises metadata, supply and the initial balance.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Constant function returning the balance of a given token owner.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using the SafeMath helpers.
Sets the allowance of a spender for msg.sender without any double-spend protection.
Transfers tokens from one account to another, deducting both balance and allowance.
Constant function returning the remaining allowance of a spender for an owner.
Approves a spender and then calls receiveApproval on that spender contract with arbitrary data.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts any plain Ether transfer.
Owner-only rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balances and allowances.
Unsigned addition c = a + b performed before the overflow guard require(c >= a).
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b performed after require(b <= a).
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b followed by the overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Unsigned division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract.
